parts.text:
Assign an L1 regularization penalty factor (LLM-Lasso protocol) to each supplied baseline measurement using only the measurement descriptions and task description (no patient records or labels). Use an integer from 1 to 5: 1 = highly predictive (minimal penalty), 2 = moderately predictive, 3 = uncertain/weak, 4 = unlikely useful, 5 = irrelevant (maximum penalty). Return strict JSON with the single top-level key "penalties" mapping every supplied field ID to its integer penalty in {1,2,3,4,5}.
{"task": "At the index myocardial infarction admission, estimate all-cause mortality within one year.", "fields": {"F2": {"description": "Initial heart rate", "name": "hr"}, "F10": {"description": "Complete heart block", "name": "av3"}, "F6": {"description": "History of cardiovascular disease", "name": "cvd"}, "F4": {"description": "Initial diastolic blood pressure", "name": "diasbp"}, "F11": {"description": "First or recurrent myocardial infarction", "name": "miord"}, "F12": {"description": "Q-wave or non-Q-wave myocardial infarction", "name": "mitype"}, "F8": {"description": "Cardiogenic shock", "name": "sho"}, "F7": {"description": "Atrial fibrillation", "name": "afb"}, "F9": {"description": "Congestive heart failure", "name": "chf"}, "F1": {"description": "Recorded sex", "name": "gender"}, "F5": {"description": "Body mass index", "name": "bmi"}, "F0": {"description": "Age in years", "name": "age"}, "F3": {"description": "Initial systolic blood pressure", "name": "sysbp"}}}
